notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full primary journal article parse spanning printed pp. 37–45, including methods, results, Tables 1–2, general discussion and references. Printed title The Influence of Self-View on Context Effects: How Display Fixtures Can Affect Product Evaluations, authors RUI (JULIET) ZHU and JOAN MEYERS-LEVY, Journal of Marketing Research, Vol. XLVI (February 2009), 37–45 match the original reference. DOI is not printed in the supplied text, so exact DOI identity cannot be independently confirmed from it. Source header names https://assets.csom.umn.edu/assets/104710.pdf; no network access performed. No PDF was supplied. Both assigned fields examined. No unique target can be identified from the supplied reference alone. Candidate sample counts: Experiment 1 Table 1, p. 40, four mutually exclusive self-view × table-surface groups, 12 + 11 + 12 + 12 = 47 participants/respondents; Experiment 2 Table 2, p. 43, four mutually exclusive self-view × tablecloth groups, 29 + 31 + 30 + 30 = 120 shoppers/respondents. These are separate experiments, never pooled. Exclusions are not explicitly described in those tables; table counts are not proof of every model-specific analytic N. Pretests also have distinct samples. None assigned to n.value. Candidate printed tests include Experiment 1 product-evaluation three-way interaction F = 18.32, p < .001 (pp. 40–41; common ANOVA df 1 and 43 stated on p. 40), plus distinct trendiness/naturalness tests F = 16.89, p < .001 and F = 7.07, p < .02; Experiment 2 neutral-mug three-way interaction F(1, 116) = 18.47, p < .001 (p. 42), plus four-way interaction F(2, 115) = 7.80, p < .001 and distinct dimension-specific tests. Experiment 2 brand-name choice has a different logistic interaction, β = –5.20, p < .001 (p. 43). These candidates are not interchangeable or matched to this row. Inspected results report F statistics, means/SDs, chi-square statistics and a logistic coefficient, but no printed Cohen f-squared effect size. No conversion performed. Unassigned p and replication/success fields are null placeholders.
